meta.title: ZK-CosmWasm | Zcash Community Grants · Permissionless.Money
meta.description: Zcash Community Grants residual: selective-disclosure smart contract VM at the edge of the Zcash ecosystem — native proof verify, light-client interop, composition demos, community audit + design-space hackathon. $240,000 ask.

hero.title: More places Zcash-grade proofs and curves can settle.
hero.essence: A selective-disclosure VM and smart-contract path for extending the edge of the Zcash ecosystem with native interop — proofs, curves, and consensus state that existing and new DAOs can verify, bridge, and compose with (CosmWasm).

side.residualNote: Residual ask · full service, compensation, compute & hackathon sponsorship
side.residualBody: Core pieces already work on testnet. This residual finishes last-mile public loops, demos, and the community audit + hackathon.
side.demosBody: Preview list live; interactive launch pending testnet wiring.

overview.lede: A selective-disclosure VM and smart-contract surface for extending the edge of the Zcash ecosystem with native interop. It verifies Zcash-grade proofs, curves, and consensus state so existing and new DAOs can bridge and compose privately with native Zcash.
overview.product1Body: Contract-side verify of Zcash-grade proofs and curves — prove a claim, settle it on-chain under the policy’s disclosure rules.
overview.product2Title: Native cross-chain bridging for Zcash state
overview.product2Body: Light clients that carry Zcash headers and finality into the same contract environment DAOs already use for composition.
overview.product3Body: Membership, voting, and access gates built from those verifies — for DAOs that already run, and for new ones that want Zcash-native privacy by default.
overview.residualBody: This is a residual request. Core pieces (proof VM, light clients, authenticator patterns) are already working on testnet. The $240k finishes last-mile work on those products: public acceptance tests, header/finality closed loops, composition demos, and a community audit + design-space hackathon.
overview.techBody: Proof-verification CosmWasm with modular VK / param storage; IBC light clients on the Crosslink path; DAO plugin commitments via vote-sdk; account gates via terp-rs smart authenticators (smart-account-auth).
overview.deskBody: ZCG residual surface: product inventory, what is live, what the $240k finishes, demos, sources, and the community event path.

problem.lede: A selective-disclosure VM and smart-contract path for extending the edge of the Zcash ecosystem with native interop — so DAOs can verify, bridge, and compose with native Zcash material.
problem.sitsBody: Privacy and consensus live in core Zcash. This residual extends the ecosystem at the edge: a contract VM and light-client surface that speak Zcash-grade proofs, curves, and headers so existing and new DAOs can act on them through native interop.
problem.deliversBody: In-contract proof verification, header and finality updates into light clients, claim binding on smart accounts, and DAO gates for membership, voting, and access — privacy composability with native Zcash across the bridge path.
problem.pathTitle: The path · Verify → Update → Bind → Gate
problem.pathIntro: Four steps from proof verify to DAO action along that edge interop path:
problem.step1Plain: Verify — settle Zcash-grade proofs in the selective-disclosure contract VM.
problem.step1Tech: Param files, circuit footer, tiered cache on the proof VM.
problem.step2Plain: Update — carry Zcash headers and finality into light clients contracts can read.
problem.step2Tech: Header / Crosslink finality ingress on the IBC light client path.
problem.step3Plain: Bind — attach verified claims to smart accounts and authenticators.
problem.step4Plain: Gate — DAO membership, voting, and access from those claims.
problem.step4Tech: DAO plugin actions and wallet-derived session material.
problem.pathCaption: Verify → Update → Bind → Gate · extending the edge of the Zcash ecosystem

events.bountyBody: We forked the ZecHub bounty-board support to run as an iframe in DAO-DAO, so ZecHub and other DAOs have access to coordinating community-led audits and focal design spaces. That surface is the control plane for audit findings, hackathon tracks, and hackathon compute credits.
events.stackTitle: Powered by the stack: ZIP-304 × ADR-032 zk-JWT light clients
events.stackBody1: The board is wired to demonstrate usage of this proof VM and light-client / authenticator gateway path.
events.stackBody2: Credits and elevated access for community audit + hackathon participants route through that plane with transparent mint/redeem intent.
events.computeBody1: Including compute sponsorship in the grant ask lets us curate an opportunity for people eager to explore using LLMs to power review and building with Zcash.
events.computeBody2: We intend to leverage that opportunity while curating an open training set of the conversations that come from audits.
events.rewardsBody: We want to use the demo stack to power Zcash coinholder voting on rewards for top demos, tracing across various stacks.
